source.edit_instruction_summary: User-directed removal of the manual lever from specimen 08; resulting image was treated as a new immutable source and fully re-reviewed because the edit regenerated the whole raster.

specimens.name: Compact foot-mounted industrial electric motor
specimens.notes: PASS: isolated ribbed TEFC-style industrial electric motor with shaft, mounting feet and top terminal box; no cable or surrounding machine.

specimens.name: Standardized motor-and-helical-gearbox package
specimens.notes: PASS: isolated standardized motor joined to an inline cast gearbox with one output shaft and repeatable industrial mounting language; no external machine.

specimens.name: Hydraulic cylinder
specimens.notes: PASS: painted hydraulic cylinder with polished rod, clevis/eye ends and two visible hose ports; no hoses attached.

specimens.name: Compact hydraulic rotary actuator
specimens.notes: PASS: compact cast hydraulic rotary actuator with mounting flange/base, keyed output shaft and two service ports; no hoses or larger mechanism.

specimens.name: Guarded V-belt drive fragment
specimens.notes: PASS: two pulleys and one V-belt are enclosed by a substantial removable yellow formed-sheet/mesh safety guard; the hazardous drive is protected while its operating principle remains clearly readable; no motor or machine.

specimens.name: Guarded roller-chain drive fragment
specimens.notes: PASS: two sprockets and chain are surrounded by a substantial formed-metal/mesh safety guard; the mechanism remains readable without becoming a completely unguarded E0-style transmission; no external machine.

specimens.name: Industrial linear solenoid actuator
specimens.notes: PASS: isolated linear electromechanical/solenoid actuator with visible coil housing, straight plunger and mounting flange; no wiring.

specimens.name: Electromagnetic clutch/brake module
specimens.notes: PASS: compact axial clutch/brake module with opposed shaft hubs, central red serviceable drum/cover, simple mounting base and top service plate. The previously objectionable manual lever is absent; no terminal box or surrounding drivetrain.

review_method: Exact untouched 1536x1024 edit result was archived to Google Drive, downloaded back from Drive, and byte-reverified at SHA-256 796426ef8d9dfd9310e76fed57d0a8ed49e8a725c5b65002264901643dcefc43 (1947491 bytes). The full sheet was visually re-reviewed specimen-by-specimen against the current E1 mechanics-infrastructure/01-assisted-drives machine spec and canonical style/era rules because the imagegen edit regenerated the raster rather than changing only a local pixel region. User art-direction explicitly requested removal of the manual lever from specimen 08. Specimens 05/06 retain protective mesh/form-sheet guards while leaving the drive principle visible, matching the canonical E1 era matrix. Specimen 08 now reads as a passive axial clutch/brake module without a manual operating lever.

supersedes_candidate.reason: User art-direction preferred the lever-free specimen 08. The replacement is a new immutable full-sheet source and was re-reviewed in full.
